question: In a certain code language, 'I Love biryani' is written as 'qs vx pg' and 'biryani was good' is written as 'vx pm ed'. How is 'biryani' written in the given code language?
solution:
The given code language is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f24cd376962bfd8f2088d540c7afe55763727e5add14f9d04bae6d8bd9149c94.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b8035914501a1349b746d2c810f8cdadf544570cac3c9f7ab95b7c9587eed1a.png]
